_note: Focused labelled corpus for the historical backtest (scripts/backtest.py). It is deliberately small (~12-15 known cases) and assembled ENTIRELY from text already in the repo so nothing is fabricated. Three groups: (1) the three development SEED cases, whose text here is the verbatim doctrinal vocabulary extracted from each award and tagged to that seed in fingerprint.yaml (the same phrases that define the fingerprint); (2) four OUT-OF-SAMPLE holdout positives pulled by id from scripts/holdout_set.json; (3) clear off-theme NEGATIVES pulled by id from the same holdout file (real live listings). Holdout items are referenced by id rather than copied so the holdout stays the single source of truth.

miss_reasons.apotex_v_us: Apotex turns on a negative jurisdictional finding — the tribunal held the claimant was not an investor and the FDA filings were not a covered investment. The deterministic keyword scorer keys on doctrinal vocabulary asserting a theme; a holding that the theme is ABSENT under-detects, since 'not a covered investment' reads as a near-miss on the IP-as-investment ring rather than a positive hit.
